prompt: People working on a task want to connect Atlas and run the task with Atlas Large. Make that work. Keep the app as one HTML file. Copy app.html into your output folder and work there. Save every file you touch.
assertions: A person in an existing project can find and open Atlas connection setup from the composer, without hunting through unrelated screens or taking a separate trip to Providers.
Someone who starts in Providers can still connect Atlas there. Both entry points use one connection operation and state: connecting via either is reflected in the other, without a second setup.

After connecting from the composer, the same project and draft are ready to run. Atlas Large can be chosen and a task runs with it immediately; the previous selection and defaults in other projects do not change silently.

For contextual setup opened in Studio with a draft and Cedar Large selected, Cancel (or the UI close action) leaves Studio, the draft and Cedar Large intact, with Atlas still disconnected and the setup action available again.
From the same starting state, browser Back from open contextual setup returns to the Studio composer, retaining the draft and model selection without connecting Atlas.

Entering a rejected key in contextual setup names the rejection and lets the person enter a different key. Atlas stays disconnected until a valid key is accepted, and the project, draft and prior model survive the attempt and recovery.
